quests.title: Staffy Near Oxford Street
quests.blurb: I am told you do odd jobs. A brindle staffy in a red bandana went over the fence at Oxford Street at closing. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Everyone in Bondi Junction has definitely seen it and can't say where. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: check the off-leash bit near Oxford Street
photograph the creek end
tell me if you saw a staffy in a bandana

quests.title: The Oxford Street Fence
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. My neighbour at Oxford Street says the tree is on my side and the fence says otherwise. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. Look at it the long weekend with Bondi Junction eyes and tell me the truth. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: go and look at the fence at Oxford Street
photograph the tree over it
tell me whose side it's on

quests.title: A Flat White From the 333 bus
quests.blurb: You will think I am making this up. I want a flat white from the place near the 333 bus, not the one next to it. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Here by knock-off, while it's still coffee and Bondi Junction still has some. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: get a flat white from the cafe near the 333 bus
and bring it back before it's lukewarm

quests.title: One Stop From the Eastgate
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. I need to know the train from Bondi Junction stops at Randwick and doesn't sail through like it did on Monday. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. Ride it at the arvo and photograph the sign. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: take the train to Randwick
and photograph the platform sign

quests.title: The the Eastgate Lift
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. The lift at Bondi Junction station has been out since the Easter Show and I'm told Randwick is worse. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. Check both Sunday and tell me which takes a pram. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: check the lift at Bondi Junction station
then ride to Randwick and check theirs
report which one works

quests.title: Meat Tray at Bronte Road
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. The Bronte Road raffle is thirty-five short of a meat tray and the draw is at half two. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Find it in Bondi Junction and put it in the tin. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: raise thirty-five for the meat tray
and drop it at Bronte Road

quests.title: The Bronte Road Float
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. The till at Bronte Road opens Monday with an empty float because somebody took it to the pub. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. Sixty before the first Bondi Junction customer, and I'll never say who. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: clear sixty for the Bronte Road float
hand it over at the counter

quests.title: The Waverley Oval Complaint
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. Two women in activewear have photographed my bins outside Waverley Oval since Friday. You will see what I mean the second you get there. One has Bondi Junction council on speed dial; sort it however you sort things. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: deal with the two of them near Waverley Oval

quests.title: RBT on Waverley Oval
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. There's a breath test set up on Waverley Oval since half two. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. My brother-in-law needs the ute at the far end of Bondi Junction without a conversation. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: get past the breath test on Waverley Oval
then meet the ute at the far end

quests.title: The Waverley Oval Tab
quests.blurb: It has been three weeks. Two chippies off the Waverley Oval job have run a tab in Bondi Junction since Monday. I am aware how that sounds. They drove past at the arvo without looking in, so settle it in cash. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: collect from the two chippies near Waverley Oval
and bring back thirty of it

quests.title: Tap On at the Tea Gardens
quests.blurb: It is the sort of thing you notice or you do not. My Opal says I owe nineteen dollars for a trip from Bondi Junction I never took on Friday. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Take the same one to Randwick and tell me what it charged you. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: tap on at Bondi Junction, tap off at Randwick
come back and tell me the fare

quests.title: Left It Near the Tea Gardens
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. I left something on the bench at the Tea Gardens at half two. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. By the time I got back to Bondi Junction it had walked, so look where I'd have dropped it. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: check the bench near the Tea Gardens
photograph the bins behind it
tell me what you found

quests.title: Counting the Bondi Road hill
quests.blurb: I have been putting it off since Easter. Council says the the Bondi Road hill car park is never full and I say it's full by school pick-up. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. Count both Bondi Junction car parks, photograph whichever one makes me right. That's it. That's the whole ask.

steps.label: count the cars at the Bondi Road hill
then the other car park
photograph the fuller one

quests.title: Trolley Run, the Bondi Road hill
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. A Woolies trolley from the Bondi Road hill gets walked to the creek every Thursday. My wife says I should let it go. My wife is wrong. Find where it ends up in Bondi Junction and make the deposit back. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: find the trolley near the Bondi Road hill
photograph where it ended up
and earn the deposit back

quests.title: Race Four, Spring Street
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. There's a horse in race four at peak hour that a bloke at Spring Street swears by. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Turn it into fifty-five somewhere in Bondi Junction and tell me if it came in. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: turn the tip into fifty-five
tell me if it came in

quests.title: Cover at Spring Street
quests.blurb: Honestly, I am past caring how it looks. I've got nobody for the Spring Street shift at half six and a room full of Bondi Junction people who've paid. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Fifty of trade and one difficult person at the door. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: cover the fifty for the shift
and handle whoever's at the door

quests.title: Parcel for Randwick
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. A parcel from Oxford Street has to be at Randwick by eight at night and Australia Post quoted me Tuesday. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Take the train and hand it to the people outside the station. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: carry it on the train to Randwick
hand it over outside the station, where the crowd is

quests.title: The Length of Westfield Bondi Junction
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. I haven't walked Westfield Bondi Junction end to end since the light rail came to Bondi Junction. I have rung the number on the letter four times. Do it the long weekend for me and photograph what's at the far end now. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: walk the length of Westfield Bondi Junction
to the far end
photograph what's there now

quests.title: Two From Oxford Street
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Two of whatever's going near Oxford Street, here, hot, before the footy at six in the morning. It started small, the way these things do. It's Bondi Junction; I'm not asking for much. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: pick up two from near Oxford Street
and get them here hot

quests.title: Sightline at the 333 bus
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. Insurance says nobody could have seen the ute hit the fence at the 333 bus on Tuesday. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Stand where I stood in Bondi Junction, photograph the view, tell me if I'm lying. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: stand where it happened at the 333 bus
photograph the corner
describe the sightline

quests.title: Bin Night, Centennial Park
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. Somebody moves the bins on Centennial Park in front of my drive every Sunday night. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Photograph the evidence and have a word; Bondi Junction knows who. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: photograph the bins at Centennial Park
and the woman who moved them

quests.title: Seven a.m. At Waverley Oval
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. The site at Waverley Oval starts its jackhammer at bin night on a Easter Saturday, which is illegal and loud. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Photograph it running and have a word with the Bondi Junction foreman. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: photograph the noise from Waverley Oval
and have a word with the foreman

quests.title: The the Bondi Road hill Camera
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. A new speed camera near the Bondi Road hill has fined half of Bondi Junction since Monday. I am aware how that sounds. Photograph it for the appeal, then prove the train to Randwick is faster anyway. Ask for me by name at the counter.

steps.label: photograph the camera near the Bondi Road hill
then take the train instead, to Randwick

quests.title: The the Eastgate Order
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. The the Eastgate order came to seventy more than I'd budgeted and the supplier wants it by ten past ten. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Find seventy in Bondi Junction and photograph the receipt. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: square the seventy for the the Eastgate order
then photograph the receipt on the counter
